info.name: PANGAEA Data Download Services DOI Filter Geo Filter API

params.name: westBoundLon
params.description: Western boundary longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

params.name: southBoundLat
params.description: Southern boundary latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

params.name: eastBoundLon
params.description: Eastern boundary longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

params.name: northBoundLat
params.description: Northern boundary latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

params.name: pangaeaParameterIDs
params.description: Comma-separated list of internal PANGAEA parameter IDs to retrieve. Parameter IDs can be found via the PANGAEA Term Dictionary API.

params.name: dateTimeMin
params.description: Start date/time filter in ISO 8601 format

params.name: dateTimeMax
params.description: End date/time filter in ISO 8601 format

params.name: depthMin
params.description: Minimum water depth in meters (below sea surface)

params.name: depthMax
params.description: Maximum water depth in meters (below sea surface)

params.name: depthMinSed
params.description: Minimum sediment/rock depth in meters below seafloor

params.name: depthMaxSed
params.description: Maximum sediment/rock depth in meters below seafloor

params.name: projectID
params.description: Internal PANGAEA project identifier to filter results

items.docs: Retrieve geoscientific measurements across multiple datasets filtered by geographic bounding box, temporal range, depth constraints, and PANGAEA parameter IDs. Ideal for extracting cross-dataset measurements from specific ocean regions, time periods, or depth intervals.
